body: Independent review of PR #209 (a11y app fixes, 8f685e1..61a174b on origin/mitosis/a11y-sweep-fixes), checked against docs/specs/a11y-fixes.md sections 9-11 and a11y-fixes.decisions.md. Nothing was changed. Worktree left clean; scratch probe tests deleted.U+000AU+000AFound 8 findings; 1 blocking.U+000AU+002D HIGH: the hidden card pill (log_actions_pill.dart) now catches finger taps and long-presses over a 96x48 area of every card, up from 66x36. Measured against base with the base file extracted via git show. It also covers the bottom 9 dp of Add a note in the day sheet.U+000AU+002D MEDIUM, all measured against base:U+000A  U+002D Calendar chevrons and This week move 7-15 dp.U+000A  U+002D Day detail back chip moves 7 dp right and the title 14 dp right.U+000A  U+002D Shell top bar grows 8 dp app-wide and the gear moves 4/4.U+000AU+002D LOW:U+000A  U+002D Entries bar grows 14 dp.U+000A  U+002D Caption's grown area swallows taps just outside the caption; the toolbar moves 13 dp while the caption is open.U+000A  U+002D Ordered-list to-do leaves a dangling "2." in the reader block label.U+000A  U+002D Sync field titles are read twice.U+000AU+000AChecked and clean:U+000AU+002D Semantic tap handlers match the finger handlers; nothing fires twice or while disabled.U+000AU+002D Excluded gestures keep a route: the editor field keeps its selection actions; the removed long-press actions passed position zero; video controls do not auto-hide under a screen reader.U+000AU+002D The composerCloseKey and dayDetailBackKey moves are safe for all callers.U+000AU+002D The #204 paths hold; no comments were added.U+000AU+002D The existing test edits are the two allowed ones.U+000AU+000AImportant context: the only goldens are StickerButton's, so "goldens pass" does not protect painted positions anywhere else.U+000AU+000AStill open: the BLOCKING gate is three named tests that must be added and pass. `flutter test` exits 79 when a --plain-name filter matches nothing, so the gate fails until they exist:U+000AU+002D log_actions_pill_test "a hidden pill does not swallow taps on the card"U+000AU+002D day_detail_header_test "the back chip keeps its painted position"U+000AU+002D bottom_bar_shell_test "the gear keeps its painted position"U+000AU+000AA human should decide how much calendar chevron movement is acceptable: some movement is unavoidable if the 48 dp areas must not overlap inside the header. The phone check should confirm that TalkBack double-tap-and-hold still gives a real long press in the reader (d5).
